description: Matches a website-checking or creation need against the jwatte.com catalog using weighted words, related terms and phrase matches. Returns up to 10 matching tools with titles, descriptions, source links and takes_url flags indicating support for browser run links.

examples.need: check my website for accessibility problems

category.description: Optional: only audits, generators or utilities.

limit.description: How many tools at most (1 to 10, default 5).

need.description: What the person wants to check or build, in their words.

name: find_tool
